technical.zh-CN: HI FLOW THF5000UT 为导热相变材料，TGP7000ULM BLU 为低模量间隙填充材料、标注 7.5W/(m·K)，TGP5000AP 为玻纤增强配方；需按压缩率与界面条件选型。
technical.en: HI FLOW THF5000UT is phase-change thermal material. TGP7000ULM BLU is a low-modulus gap filler rated 7.5W/(m·K); TGP5000AP is glass-fiber reinforced. Selection depends on compression and interface conditions.
